embedded_ivos.text: A massive amount of data is needed to unleash the power of AI, but I’m concerned that the Trump Administration might be handing our data to tech companies rather than protecting it or using it for the common good. Hence why Musk’s DOGE minions are embedded in dozens of federal departments and agencies.

deepseek.reason: The speaker mentions DOGE staff embedded in federal agencies, not independent auditors embedded in AI labs.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The embedding refers to DOGE in government agencies, not AI lab IVOs.

ai_action_plan_2025.text:
Trump’s AI Action Plan & new executive orders are deeply troubling & undermine responsible AI innovation.
 
My AI Caucus colleagues & I will keep fighting for policies that safeguard AI development & fully leverage the potential of AI for all Americans without giving a handout to Big Tech.
